codeReview.summary: Clean implementation of the Correlation section on the mitigation detail page. All feature requirements are fully covered: CorrelationContext interface added to api.ts with proper optional typing, Mitigation interface extended with optional correlation field, correlation card renders signal group link (Next.js Link), derived confidence with visual progress bar, source count with name badges, corroboration badge (green Corroborated / amber Pending), contributing sources table sourced from useSignalGroupDetail hook, and Why explanation text. Non-correlated mitigations show muted 'Single-source mitigation' message via a separate card. The useSignalGroupDetail hook is conditionally invoked with null when no correlation exists, preventing unnecessary API calls. 8 well-structured Vitest tests cover correlated rendering, non-correlated rendering, missing correlation field, pending corroboration, signal group link href, contributing sources table, and hook parameter passing. Build and tests pass cleanly.

issues.description: No loading indicator for the contributing sources table while useSignalGroupDetail is fetching. When a correlated mitigation loads, the confidence bar and source badges appear immediately (from mitigation.correlation), but the Contributing Sources table appears with a slight delay once the signal group detail API resolves. A subtle skeleton or spinner would improve perceived responsiveness, but the current behavior is acceptable since the rest of the correlation card is already visible.

summary: Feature passes review. The Correlation section is correctly added to the mitigation detail page with all required elements: signal group link, confidence bar, source count with badges, corroboration badge, contributing sources table, and explanation text. Non-correlated mitigations show the specified muted message. The CorrelationContext type and Mitigation interface update are backward-compatible. 8 comprehensive tests verify both correlated and non-correlated paths. Only non-blocking observation: no loading state for the contributing sources table while signal group detail is being fetched.
